# InterviewBit

> > InterviewBit is a comprehensive coding interview preparation platform offering programming practice, algorithm challenges, and technical interview preparation with job referrals to top companies.

InterviewBit helps software engineers prepare for technical interviews at companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Adobe, Visa, DE Shaw, and Zomato through structured coding challenges and practice problems. The platform covers major programming languages including Java, C++, Python, and HTML, with resources ranging from algorithm practice to development tools and career guidance.

## Key Topics

- Coding Interview Preparation
- Programming Practice
- Algorithm Practice
- Technical Interviews
